_doc: PR-D (2026-05-30) — user-facing strings for the 5-tab Settings IA (Overview / AI Setup / Knowledge Index / Tools / Advanced). Loaded via TemplateManager.loadJson(ConfigTemplateId.Settings). Vocabulary contract: Profile→Provider, Quick→Fast Lookup, Deep→Research, Premium/online tier→Use stronger model when needed, Embedding→Knowledge Index, Web Search slot→Web Access, MCP Servers→External tools, Permission mode→Safety, Agent Harness→Agent runtime. The word "Harness" is allowed ONLY inside the Advanced tab. Edit values freely; the Settings UI falls back to DEFAULT_SETTINGS_STRINGS in src/ui/view/settings/settingsStrings.ts if any key is missing.

readiness.sectionSub: Check what is ready and what needs attention before using Peak.
readiness.empty: No surfaces have reported readiness yet. Surfaces (Chat, Vault Search, Copilot, etc.) register themselves at startup — give it a moment, or check the console if this persists.

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.usedBy: The main Chat view and its “Auto” default model. Also the fallback for the ✦ Refine button (when Fast Lookup is unset) and for escalation (when “Use stronger model” is unset).

fastLookup.title: Fast Lookup
fastLookup.desc: Single-step replies, ~1s (works well with small local models). Also drives the ✦ Refine button in Vault Search.
fastLookup.usedBy: The ✦ Refine button and natural-language search parsing, the “Fast” mode of Auto/Vault Review, the follow-up chat tabs in AI Analysis results, and mid-run context compaction.

research.title: Research

strongerModel.title: Use stronger model when needed
strongerModel.desc: Cloud model used as the fallback when local tiers are not enough.
strongerModel.usedBy: Escalation only: deep runs switch to this model when a step’s confidence is low (cascade must be on). No feature starts here.

knowledgeIndex.title: Knowledge Index
knowledgeIndex.desc: Model used to power semantic vault search.
knowledgeIndex.usedBy: Semantic / vector vault search at query time and building the search index. Not a chat model.

providers.sectionSub: AI services and local runtimes connected to Peak.

safety.sectionSub: How Peak handles risky writes and tool calls.

recentLimit.title: Recent history limit

intro.sectionSub: Low-level runtime, storage, and diagnostics. Most users do not need to change anything here.

dataFolder.title: Data storage folder
dataFolder.desc: Folder for storing plugin data files (e.g., search database). Defaults under the chat root.

chatRoot.desc: Root folder for Peak-owned AI data. Prompts, Skills, Attachments, Hub-Summaries and DataStore derive from it by default.

appearance.sectionSub: Control how rich AI responses are rendered in Chat Studio.

codeTheme.title: Code block theme
codeTheme.desc: Syntax colours used for code in messages, reasoning, and reports. Changes apply immediately.

attachmentHandling.desc: How attachments are sent to the model. "Direct" requires model vision support; "Degrade to text" uses OCR/parsing for compatibility.

devTools.title: Enable DevTools Graph Inspector
devTools.desc: Exposes window.testGraphTools in browser DevTools console with convenience methods for graph testing.

reRunBanner.title: Re-run setup wizard
reRunBanner.description: Let the setup assistant re-pick tier bindings from your current environment.

backend.info: Which loop engine runs agents. The in-process runtime sits on top of Vercel AI SDK and supports any Provider (Claude, GPT, Ollama, OpenRouter). The Claude Agent SDK runtime is Anthropic’s official SDK (Anthropic models only). Vault Search currently requires the Claude Agent SDK runtime until its tools are adapted.
backend.fieldHint: Picks the loop engine; per-tier model selection is via Tier Bindings below.

options.auto: Auto (in-process where supported, Claude Agent SDK for the rest)
options.harness: In-process runtime (Vercel AI SDK, any Provider)

tierBindings.info: Pick which model serves each tier. The Fast Lookup and Research tiers usually use local Providers (Ollama); the “stronger model” tier usually uses cloud Providers (Anthropic, OpenRouter). Unset tiers are skipped when the runtime cascades.

fastTier.label: Fast Lookup (local)
fastTier.hint: Single-step replies, ~1s (works well with 14B local models)

researchTier.label: Research (local)
researchTier.hint: Multi-step reasoning / long documents (works well with 32B+ local models)

strongerTier.label: Use stronger model when needed
strongerTier.hint: Cloud model used as the fallback when local tiers are not enough

escalation.allowFieldHint: Auto-upgrade to the next tier on low confidence
escalation.thresholdFieldHint: Escalate when step score falls below this (0–1)

safety.fieldHint: Controls how agents handle write operations to your vault.

hooks.description: Hook configuration DSL is not yet available. This section will allow defining deny rules and command hooks for pre_tool_use / post_tool_use events.

externalTools.title: External tools
externalTools.description: Connect external tool servers to extend agent capabilities with additional commands.
externalTools.emptyHint: No external tools configured. Add one to get started.

tabIntro.sectionSub: Configure image / video / music / TTS routing. Big preset tables live in templates/config/media-generation.json — this tab exposes only the fields users typically tweak.

route.sectionSub: Which provider Chat and Composer try first. Auto prefers Native when a compatible profile exists, otherwise falls back to fal.ai.
route.optionAutoDesc: Prefer Native, fall back to fal.ai.

fal.sectionSub: API key and where downloaded assets are written into your vault.
fal.keyDesc: Get a key at fal.ai/dashboard/keys. Stored locally in data.json.
fal.attachmentFolderDesc: Vault-relative folder where generated media is saved. Leave empty to use the default under your Chat root.

presets.sectionSub: Choose which preset (from media-generation.json) each kind uses as its default, plus optional per-field overrides. Only model + bounds are editable here; the full preset table stays in templates/config.
presets.emptyOverridesHint: No overrides — Chat / Composer use the preset from media-generation.json.
presets.musicLicensingBody: Commercial rights for generated music are governed by fal.ai's Terms of Service plus the upstream model's own terms (the default lyria2 endpoint is a Google Lyria model). fal does not warrant copyright ownership of outputs. Lyria audio carries a non-removable SynthID watermark identifying it as AI-generated; major distribution platforms and the EU AI Act require AI disclosure, and prompt-only music is presumed non-copyrightable under current US Copyright Office guidance. Review the provider terms before any commercial release — TTS (Kokoro, open weights, commercial use allowed) is a separate model with separate terms and is not covered by this note.
presets.musicLicensingConfirmCheckboxLabel: I have read and accept the music licensing terms.
presets.musicLicensingConfirmHint: First-run only — this is remembered per policy version.

native.sectionSub: Which OpenAI profile drives the Native route. Only OpenAI-kind profiles with an API key can serve image generation today.
native.noProfilesHint: No OpenAI profile is configured. Add one under AI Setup → Providers before using the Native route.

status.sectionSub: What Chat/Composer see right now for each route × kind. Validate runs local shape checks only — it never contacts fal.ai or OpenAI, and never spends money.
status.validateDisclaimer: Validation runs locally — it checks key presence, endpoint shape, and profile availability. It does NOT reach out to fal.ai or OpenAI; a successful validation does not guarantee remote connectivity.
